description: Day-1 bootstrap-the-bootstrap. Run once when a user first clones coltrane-oss. Conducts a sweep of the user's existing local repos, distills implicit patterns into draft agents/standards/types, and lets the user accept/reject before adoption. The cold-start solution: instead of preseeding abstract defaults, the framework LEARNS the user from their own work and then tunes the preseed to their domain. Seeding exercise, not ongoing crawl.

phases.name: discover
phases.intent: Diverge. Scan the user's home directory (default: ~/) for git repositories. Per repo, produce a SURVEY-LEVEL repo-survey signal: README first lines, manifest files, commit rhythm (30d), top-level structure, CLAUDE.md/.claude presence. Apoha: SURVEY ONLY — no deep code read, no file-by-file analysis. Bound by frozen-params: top-N most-recently-touched repos (default N=20), max-depth 1 below ~/, skip node_modules + venv + .git internals.

phases.name: define
phases.intent: Converge. From the repo-survey cohort, extract a pattern-extraction interpretation: user_signature (one-line characterization), recurrent_workflows (multi-step sequences observed across repos), agent_like_roles (implicit roles the user plays), recurrent_domain_shapes (data shapes the user repeatedly works with). SEAL the predict: 'these N patterns are real + these M agents/standards/types are worth drafting'. The kill: pattern_extraction.confidence_band = low across all observations. The apoha: this DOES NOT propose anything specific to a future project — it only names the user's existing work-shape. Compute sha256_pre_verdict via prereg_seal.

phases.name: develop
phases.intent: Generate drafts. For each agent_like_role → emit a draft-agent-profile with proposed primitives + system_prompt + tools_allowlist. For each recurrent_workflow → emit a draft-standard with phases. For each recurrent_domain_shape → emit a draft-domain-type with extends + schema. All start at user_acceptance: pending. Present drafts to the user inline (conductor mode). User reviews + responds (accept / reject / refine). On accept: write to .coltrane/agents/, .coltrane/standards/, .coltrane/types/. On refine: user edits inline, then accept. On reject: discard. NEVER auto-adopt — user accepts every artifact at the boundary.

phases.name: deliver
phases.intent: Ripen + report. Emit a seeding-verdict: how many surveyed, how many extracted, how many drafted, how many accepted/refined/rejected per kind. Compute ripeness: RIPENED (every kind had ≥1 acceptance), PARTLY-RIPENED (some kinds empty), RIPENED-DIFFERENTLY (user refined heavily — different fruit than predicted), KILL-FIRED (low confidence + no acceptances), ABORTED (user stopped mid-flight). Update the user's README to mirror the active fleet (Claude-maintained 'active projects' section). Next-step hint: typically 'now run project-bootstrap-v0 --use-case <inferred>'.

conductor_mode.description: User clones coltrane-oss, says 'let's do seed-from-local-repos-v0' or 'fan out and learn about my work from my local repos'. Claude reads this standard, walks the 4 phases, prompts the user at each seal-seam + each draft-acceptance moment.
user_invocation_examples: fan out and learn about my work from my local repos
seed coltrane from my existing repos

dispatch_mode.description: Power-user: each phase dispatched as a subagent via Task tool. Allowlist enforcement at the subagent boundary.

execution_modes.score_is_the_same: The standard JSON IS the score regardless of mode.

apoha: NOT an ongoing crawl — this is a one-time seeding exercise. Re-running it later is allowed (e.g., quarterly) but each run is a discrete seal-cycle.
NOT a code-aware deep read — survey-level only. Repo-survey signals capture shape, not mechanism.
NOT auto-adoption — every draft requires user accept at the develop→deliver seam.
NOT scanning everything — bounded by top-N + max-depth + skip-list. Frozen ex-ante per R5.
NOT a replacement for project-bootstrap-v0 — this seeds the FRAMEWORK; project-bootstrap-v0 seeds individual PROJECTS. Two layers.
